notes: v1.14.585 — RESTORE HONESTY. DATA-HONESTY-COMMAND Batch 2 P0 sub-ship 2, owner GO 2026-09-09 ('GO on .585 restore honesty'), handoff rev 2 §1: show what will be replaced, validate the backup before applying, report partial or failed recovery honestly. ONE VISIBLE CHANGE: the restore's two dialogs tell the truth. WHAT WAS WRONG: phantomImport() confirmed by listing what was IN the file, never what is ON THIS DEVICE that the file overwrites or clears (five deploy sections are written on every restore even when the file lacks them); orphaned records were filtered out silently; a bundle whose manifest says a store failed to read (included:false / partial:true, the .584 vocabulary) was offered as a normal restore; a structurally damaged file could reach the write set; discrepancy photos are exported and never restored and nothing said so; the completion alert said 'Restore complete' whatever happened, and a Ghost Echo IndexedDB failure produced no report and no reload. NOW, before any write: phantom_restoreValidate refuses a damaged file ('Backup file is damaged — <reason>. Nothing was changed.') on a section of the wrong type or a manifest recordCount that does not match the list it describes; the confirm reads, per section, 'N on this device → M in backup', names CLEARED (an always-written section the file lacks), kept (an optional section the file lacks), the registry keys that overwrite keys already on the device, DROPPED orphans by kind, PARTIAL BACKUP with the store named and this device's Ghost Echo count KEPT, and photos the restore cannot carry. After: 'Restore complete. N keys written (M from the registry). Dropped … Ghost Echo: restored K / KEPT this device's K — the backup had none readable / NOT restored (reason) — this device's entries are unchanged; everything else was restored.' Every IndexedDB outcome (error, blocked, abort, 15 s timeout) ends in a report and the reload. THE WRITE SET IS UNCHANGED: the referential-integrity predicates moved verbatim into phantom_restoreOrphans, computed once above the confirm, so the DROPPED line and the writes count the same records. The device Ghost Echo count goes through GE.init(), the engine's own door. Native confirm()/alert() are kept — the change is what they say, not the mechanism. ⚠ LEADS, NOT FIXED HERE: discrepancy photos are still not restored (photoStore write path, its own ship); the always-written deploy sections clearing device data when the file lacks them is pre-existing replace semantics, now disclosed, not changed — owner to rule if 'blank is never an erase' should apply to restore. PINNED by test/e2e/52-restore-honesty.spec.js (8): device→backup lines and CLEARED; orphans in the confirm and the report; PARTIAL keeps this device's Ghost Echo before and after; damaged (wrong type) refused with every key byte-identical; damaged (manifest mismatch) refused; photos disclosed; the report counts what was written and Ghost Echo restores from a full backup; a Ghost Echo write failure is reported with this device's entries unchanged and the rest landed.
